(a) we present a novel model called KRU that reduces the parameter size by three orders of magnitute, (b) the KRU model is flexible, and can be used in a wide range of applications, (c) the KRU is a competitive model that can achieve the state of the art performance in a number of tasks, and (d) the KRU can reduce training time significantly.

(i) the recurrent matrix in RNNs can be efficiently factored using a Kronecker product, (ii) the factors of the Kronecker product can be constrained to be unitary, and (iii) the resulting model, called Kronecker RNNs (KRNNs), achieves parameter efficiency in terms of the number of parameters in the recurrent matrix, while maintaining competitive statistical performance
